prompt: Create an original 90 second instrumental dub instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: round electric bass, organ, rimshot, echo guitar. Style: spacious offbeat chords with restrained tape delay. Tempo approximately 80 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A smooth, laid-back instrumental track featuring a clean electric guitar melody over a steady bass and drum groove. It evokes a relaxed and slightly reflective mood.
description.zh: 一首流畅、轻松的纯音乐，以干净的电吉他旋律为主，配以稳定的贝斯和鼓点。营造出一种放松而略带沉思的氛围。
